The credible positive material is mostly about technical safety oversight and civilian emergency preparedness, while the stronger evidence shows administrative and anti-terror controls being used for political pressure and repression.","evidence":[{"title":"World Report 2024: Türkiye","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey","summary":"HRW says the government’s security apparatus and courts were used in ways that kept torture, custody abuse, and political repression largely unchecked, rather than narrowly and lawfully controlled.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Türkiye government removes elected opposition mayors","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-11-06","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors","summary":"Erdoğan’s government removed elected mayors, dissolved councils, detained a mayor on terrorism charges, and police violently dispersed protests. This is strong evidence of administrative control and anti-terror tools being used for intimidation and political control.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"Türkiye: Kurdish politicians convicted in unjust mass trial","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-05-16","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial","summary":"A Turkish court convicted 24 Kurdish politicians in what HRW calls a manifestly political trial on bogus state-security charges, indicating security law used for repression rather than lawful restraint.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Freedom in the World 2024: Turkey","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says due process was severely compromised, courts often ignored higher-court rulings, and prosecutors did not consistently investigate torture or custody abuse.
